selection_policy: All declared models and positions are captured prospectively on identical eligible rows; the QB lead does not exclude negative controls or permit in-season selection.

season_lock.time_safe_feature_updates: prior completed weeks may update lagged features, but model parameters and candidate definitions remain locked for the season

weekly_freeze.primary_cutoff: single immutable capture inside the existing verified 18-hour window before the week's first kickoff
weekly_freeze.missed_capture_policy: record a typed missed-capture manifest; never reconstruct a forecast from a later endpoint or model run

subgroups.unknown_policy: retain UNKNOWN as an explicit subgroup value; never fill it from later information

probability_policy.missing_probability_policy: null with a typed blocker; never synthesize confidence

scoring_replay.profiles: every enabled league profile captured at forecast time across all six supported formats

decision_utility.policy: Record research-only counterfactual selections from the same point-in-time roster, player pool, lineup, and scoring contract. Never alter or label an app recommendation.

outcomes.evaluation_policy: Every report names one locked outcome revision and excludes unresolved identity or missing-result rows from all models symmetrically.

evidence_checkpoints.interim_research: descriptive only after at least 8 completed weeks; no selection or approval
evidence_checkpoints.season_close: Sol review after a completed season and locked outcome revision
evidence_checkpoints.promotion_gate: The Tranche 6A four-completed-outer-season gate remains unchanged; prospective weeks or one season do not replace it.

implementation_sequence: 7B Terra: schema, fixture, deterministic validators, and missed-capture behavior
7C Terra: operational forecast, scoring-replay, decision-trace, and outcome workflows after 7B closure
7D Operations: accrue evidence without model selection or app changes
7E Sol: review only after a declared evidence checkpoint
